title: GTM Data Modeling & Data Quality
summary: Build the dependable data foundation behind GTM reporting, automation, and decision-making.
outcome_headline: Create a GTM data foundation your reports and workflows can trust
overview: This work connects CRM, marketing, product, and operational data into a shared analytical model. It defines the entities, relationships, and business logic that let teams answer the same question consistently across reports and workflows.
business_value: Companies need this when source systems disagree, metric definitions drift, or every new analysis requires manual reconciliation. A governed analytical layer reduces reporting ambiguity, makes downstream automation safer, and gives revenue teams a foundation they can extend without rebuilding the logic each time.
benefits: Consistent GTM definitions | Reusable reporting datasets | Faster analysis | Earlier detection of data issues
output_1_build: Source mappings, ingestion logic, identity rules, and a documented integrated model.
output_1_value: A reliable base for cross-channel reporting and activation.
output_2_build: Modular staging, intermediate, and mart models with documented dependencies.
output_2_value: Reusable logic that is easier to test, review, and maintain.
output_3_build: Fact and dimension models designed around recurring GTM questions.
output_3_value: Clear relationships and more dependable funnel analysis.
technologies: SQL | dbt | Cloud data warehouses | CRM data | Marketing-platform data | BI tools
evidence_summary: Demonstrates how CRM and revenue data can be organized into reusable models for consistent reporting and analysis.

title: Sales Pipeline & Funnel Analytics
summary: Turn opportunity and activity data into a clear view of conversion, velocity, coverage, and sales performance.
outcome_headline: Make pipeline movement, conversion, and velocity visible
overview: This work creates the datasets and analytical views required to understand how pipeline is created, progresses, stalls, and converts. It connects stage history, ownership, timing, and commercial outcomes so leaders can distinguish a reporting symptom from the underlying operating problem.
business_value: Companies need pipeline analytics when forecasts are difficult to explain, stage conversion is unclear, or performance reviews depend on manually assembled spreadsheets. Reliable funnel analysis helps leaders focus coaching, capacity, process, and investment decisions on the stages that constrain revenue.
benefits: Visible conversion constraints | Comparable stage performance | Clearer pipeline movement | Decision-ready sales reporting
output_1_build: Stage, segment, source, owner, and cohort conversion datasets and views.
output_1_value: A clearer diagnosis of funnel leakage and improvement opportunities.
output_2_build: A stage-history model with entries, exits, regressions, skipped stages, and time in stage.
output_2_value: A defensible account of pipeline progression and process adherence.
output_3_build: Velocity measures combining volume, value, conversion, and sales-cycle duration.
output_3_value: Better visibility into the mechanisms driving pipeline output.
technologies: SQL | dbt | CRM opportunity history | BI tools | Spreadsheets for QA
evidence_summary: Demonstrates opportunity-stage reconstruction, conversion analysis, pipeline velocity, and reusable reporting datasets.

title: ICP Account Discovery & Enrichment
summary: Find, qualify, enrich, and validate the accounts and contacts a GTM motion should pursue.
outcome_headline: Turn an ICP definition into qualified, CRM-ready account data
overview: This work translates an ICP hypothesis into a usable account and contact dataset. It combines discovery criteria, enrichment sources, validation rules, and field normalization so the output can support prospecting, segmentation, routing, and measurement inside the CRM.
business_value: Companies need this when market lists are incomplete, research is performed manually, or enriched fields are too inconsistent to support action. A controlled enrichment workflow improves targeting quality and gives operators a repeatable way to produce CRM-ready data.
benefits: More relevant account coverage | Less manual research | Consistent qualification fields | CRM-ready output
output_1_build: Search criteria, source strategy, qualification logic, and a deduplicated account dataset.
output_1_value: A reviewable market universe aligned to the commercial thesis.
output_2_build: A Clay table with waterfalls, enrichment logic, conditional runs, and normalized output fields.
output_2_value: Repeatable research with better control over data quality and cost.
output_3_build: Explicit qualification rules, confidence checks, and exclusion reasons.
output_3_value: Fewer low-quality records entering sales workflows.
technologies: Clay | Enrichment providers | CRM | Spreadsheets | APIs | Validation rules
evidence_summary: Demonstrates account discovery, Clay enrichment, field normalization, qualification, and preparation for activation.

title: Lead Qualification & Workflow Automation
summary: Automate qualification, assignment, routing, and CRM updates without losing control of exceptions.
outcome_headline: Replace manual lead triage with consistent, observable workflows
overview: This work turns operational rules into dependable workflows. It covers how records enter the system, how they are qualified and assigned, how duplicates and exceptions are handled, and how the resulting state is written back to the CRM and monitored.
business_value: Companies need this when response depends on manual review, routing logic is difficult to audit, or automation breaks silently. A well-designed workflow reduces repetitive handling while preserving ownership, traceability, and a clear path for exceptions.
benefits: Faster record handling | Consistent assignment rules | Fewer duplicate actions | Visible exceptions and failures
output_1_build: A workflow that validates inputs, evaluates routing rules, assigns an owner, and records the decision.
output_1_value: Faster, more consistent handoff to the appropriate GTM motion.
output_2_build: A centralized decision table and workflow logic for assignment and fallback handling.
output_2_value: Clearer ownership and easier rule maintenance.
output_3_build: Lookup, match, merge-or-update, and idempotency controls before downstream actions run.
output_3_value: Cleaner CRM data and fewer conflicting notifications or assignments.
technologies: n8n | CRM APIs | Webhooks | JavaScript | JSON | Enrichment services
evidence_summary: Demonstrates validation, geographic and segment assignment, duplicate handling, CRM integration, and explicit exception paths.

title: Lead Scoring & Buying-Signal Activation
summary: Translate fit, engagement, and product signals into explainable priority and timely sales action.
outcome_headline: Turn fit and buying signals into explainable sales priority
overview: This work defines which signals matter, how they should be combined, and how the resulting priority should appear inside the CRM and daily sales workflow. It includes the model, the activation logic, and the feedback needed to review performance over time.
business_value: Companies need this when teams have more leads or accounts than they can evaluate manually, or when useful buying signals never reach the right owner. An explainable scoring and activation system concentrates attention while giving operators a clear way to inspect and improve the logic.
benefits: More consistent prioritization | Explainable score components | Faster signal activation | Reviewable model performance
output_1_build: A transparent fit model with documented features, weights, exclusions, and score bands.
output_1_value: A repeatable view of which accounts best match the commercial thesis.
output_2_build: A time-aware engagement model with event weights, decay, thresholds, and account aggregation.
output_2_value: A clearer view of meaningful activity rather than raw volume.
output_3_build: Modeled usage features, thresholds, and interpretable signal definitions.
output_3_value: Product behavior becomes usable context for GTM prioritization.
technologies: SQL | dbt | CRM | Product events | Marketing engagement data | Workflow automation
evidence_summary: Demonstrates signal selection, transparent weighting, priority bands, CRM activation, and a repeatable review process.
